# Third-party browser libraries

Served from CTEM itself (no CDN), unmodified. Update by downloading the npm tarball, checking it against the
registry's published sha512 integrity, and copying the file across with its LICENSE and NOTICE.

The precheck's house-style checks (em dashes, spelling, example IPs) skip this folder; it is not our code.
